output.brief: The rise in ratequote's 5xx rate (0.31% to 0.41%) is most likely ordinary week-to-week variation. The week sits well under the normal-band edge (0.48%) and the burn-rate page did not fire. The rollout comparison that blamed v4.18 is explained by cache warm-up on new pods, which appears in every rollout, including a config-only redeploy with no code change. The dashboard counts match the raw logs, so it is not a counting artefact. I am moderately confident v4.18 did not cause the rise, but I have not checked the read-replica move (28 Oct) or partner-sync's month-end timing, so those remain open. Next: do not roll back v4.18 and do not mute alerting, which would remove a protective control. Record the week at ops review as within the normal band and check the following week. If the next week is high, check the replica move and confirm partner-sync's run dates.
